#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long mod_add(long long a, long long b) {
    long long v = a + b;
    return v < MOD ? v : v - MOD;
}

long long mod_sub(long long a, long long b) {
    long long v = a - b;
    return v < 0 ? v + MOD : v;
}

long long mod_mul(long long a, long long b) {
    return (a * b) % MOD;
}

long long mod_pow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) res = mod_mul(res, a);
        a = mod_mul(a, a);
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long mod_inv(long long a) {
    return mod_pow(a, MOD - 2);
}

vector<long long> fact, inv_fact;

void build_fact(int n) {
    fact.resize(n + 1);
    inv_fact.resize(n + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        fact[i] = mod_mul(fact[i-1], i);
    }
    inv_fact[n] = mod_inv(fact[n]);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        inv_fact[i] = mod_mul(inv_fact[i+1], i + 1);
    }
}

long long nCr(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
    return mod_mul(fact[n], mod_mul(inv_fact[r], inv_fact[n - r]));
}

long long small_inv(int n) {
    return mod_mul(inv_fact[n], fact[n - 1]);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    build_fact(n + m);

    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = mod_mul(mod_mul(p, n - i), small_inv(n + m - i));
        phaseSize = mod_add(phaseSize, p);
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        long long numPhases = mod_mul(m + k, small_inv(k));
        long long term = mod_mul(nCr(n, k), mod_mul(numPhases, phaseSize));
        if (k & 1)
            answer = mod_add(answer, term);
        else
            answer = mod_sub(answer, term);
    }

    cout << answer << endl;
    return 0;
}
